purpose: Measurement-only same-machine current-pin versus isolated-candidate VT upgrade comparison; never terminal user data.

steps.contract: ASCII, Japanese wide-cell UTF-8, emoji, and a second double-width code point
bold 16-color, truecolor, reset, and OSC 8 open/text/close
cursor positioning, erase-line, scroll-region, scroll up/down, alternate-screen enter/exit
RGBA 1x1 image 77, direct transmit-and-display, m=1, base64 fragment /wAA
placement count remains zero before completion
image 77, m=0, base64 fragment /w==; exactly one placement then completes conversion and upload
DCS bytes above 0x7F remain byte-observable for the named candidate delta
DSR status, cursor-position, and primary-device-attributes queries produce deterministic PTY output
dimensions, cursor, grapheme UTF-8, width, hyperlink, selection, semantic style/colors, and Kitty placement/image pixels
hidden HWND, Direct2D structured steady-state render after Kitty conversion/upload warmup

digests.corpus: SHA-256 of the length-delimited canonical ordered VT-write and action stream
digests.ptyOutput: SHA-256 of the exact Ghostty write-PTY callback byte stream
digests.snapshot: SHA-256 of semantic snapshot-v1 bytes; excludes monotonic generation identifiers, addresses, allocation sizes, capacity, and other engine storage details
digests.withoutExpectedDeltas: Untimed PTY-output and semantic-snapshot control digests from the same corpus with the declared DCS high-byte step omitted; current-pin and candidate values must be byte-exact

measurements.contract: queue, active source/conversion, ready/resident/high-water, cache, pinned, upload, placement count and bytes
maximum observed private bytes and process peak working set

expectedDeltas.allowedOnlyWhen: candidate behavior differs because the reviewed upstream DCS high-byte correction is present; every other PTY and snapshot digest remains exact

safety.archiveContent: digests, counters, metadata, and bounded raw timing samples only
